query: Set up a new repo at ../my-service for Codex with the hub skills python-code-style and python-unit-tests.
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/scaffold.py with --dry-run before writing anything
Installs each named skill under .agents/skills/<name>/ in the destination, not the hub's domain folder layout
Does not copy evals/ into the destination
Creates AGENTS.md listing the installed skills only if it does not already exist

query: Scaffold ../app for Codex with the hub skill python-style-guide.
expected_behavior: Reports that python-style-guide does not exist and shows the available names from the script error
Asks or suggests python-code-style instead of inventing a skill

query: Add python-docstrings to ../legacy-repo for Codex. It already has AGENTS.md with our team rules.
expected_behavior: Installs the skill and tells the user the instruction file was kept

query: Write a new skill for our hub that explains Databricks billing tables.
expected_behavior: Does not run the scaffold script
Defers to writing-agent-skills for authoring a skill

query: Scaffold ../app for Claude Code with python-code-style.
expected_behavior: Recognises the request is for Claude Code, not Codex, and does not write .agents/skills/
